extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners, PTO enrollment/discipline staff, and the public
extracted.subtask_description: An official PTO notice documenting the transfer of a registered patent practitioner to disability inactive status under 37 C.F.R. § 11.28, including effective date, identifying information, and the effect on the practitioner's ability to practice before the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority for transfer (37 C.F.R. § 11.28)
rubrics_metrics.description: Transfer to disability inactive status is effected under 37 C.F.R. § 11.28.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document states: 'Effective October 1, 2020, the Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline for the United States Patent and Trademark Office ("Office") has transferred Wayne V. Harper ... to disability inactive status under 37 C.F.R. § 11.28.' The notice is signed/dated by the Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of disability inactive status (prohibition on practice)
rubrics_metrics.description: While on disability inactive status, the registrant may not practice before the Office in patent, trademark, and other non-patent matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim from the notice: 'While on disability inactive status, Mr. Harper may not practice before the Office in patent, trademark, and other non-patent matters.' This is stated as the operative consequence of the status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required notice content / identifying information
rubrics_metrics.description: The notice identifies the respondent by name, city/state, and registration number, provides the proceeding number, and states the effective date and authorizing official.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document includes: 'Wayne V. Harper', 'Tampa, Florida', 'Registration No. 55,839', 'Proceeding No. D2020-10', effective date 'October 1, 2020', and the name/title/signature of the Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline (William R. Covey).
